capabilities: preview verses for Bible references written in any note
import Bible translations from EPUB and HTML files
read and search Bible chapters in a reader tab
compare up to four translations side by side
find notes that cite a passage via a usage index
disambiguation: More than previews: it also includes a Bible reader, verse search, translation comparison, text insertion and a usage index.
extras: The plugin contains no Bible text and makes no network requests; users must download translation files themselves from jw.org, eBible.org or dbs.org and check each translation's license. Translations are stored in the plugin folder, not synced across devices. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian shows Bible references as plain text with no way to see the verse text or read a passage without leaving the note.
summary: Bible reference tool that recognizes Bible references in notes and previews verses from locally imported EPUB and HTML translations.
